node.subject: english
node.title: 多元文化
node.summary: 能用英语讨论多元文化
node.content_req: 在第四学段 (7~9 年级)教学情境中,能用英语讨论多元文化。
key_points: 能用英语讨论多元文化
在第四学段 (7~9 年级)教学情境中
能识别至少 3 个国家特有的日常习俗 (如日本吃面出声、巴西用筷子等) 并用英语说出对应国家名称
能描述同一情境下不同国家做法完全相反的具体例子 (如吃饭、问候、餐桌礼仪) 并用英语对比说明
能解释多元文化差异背后的历史、地理或社会原因, 并用英语反驳 '多文化只是一起吃饭' 这类简化看明白
node.academic_req: 能在多元文化主题情境下, 用英语识别不同国家特有的日常习俗, 描述同一意思下不同文化的反差做法, 并解释其背后的文化原因.
node.assessment_prompt: {{name}}能不能说出 2 个「同一个意思不同国家做法完全相反」的例子, 并用英语解释为啥会这样?\n假设班里要办「多元文化日」, 每个{{name}}介绍自己家乡的一个奇怪习俗, 选哪个国家、讲哪件事, 为什么别人听了会觉得「哇塞还有这种操作」?\n如果有人跟{{name}}说「多文化就是大家一起吃顿饭嘛」, 能用英语反驳 ta, 举出至少 1 个真正需要磨合的例子吗?
node.description: 多伦多一条街上能听到 180 种语言, 这不是段子是事实. 让孩子做一件具体事: 选 3 个国家 (比如日本、巴西、尼日利亚), 各查 1 件「只有那边才这样做」的日常小事——日本人吃面要出声、巴西人

node.common_mistakes: 学生把「different cultures」写成「differents cultures」(形容词复数误加 s);学生把「Western countries」漏写 s 写成「Western country」,前后主谓不一致;
node.teaching_activity: 用 8 张国旗卡片 (中国、美国、英国、日本、法国、巴西、埃及、澳大利亚) 抽 4 张让小组合作,每人写 3 句介绍该国文化 (食物、节日、礼仪),计时 4 分钟贴在教室墙面「文化走廊」,让全班用句型「In ___ ,
node.teaching_voice: 我们来看,多元文化就是同一个动作,各国做法完全不同。想象你去朋友家吃面,日本朋友吸溜出声是夸好吃,你要是安静吃完他反而觉得你不喜欢——这就叫文化差异。记住,现在挑日本、巴西、尼日利亚,各查一件'只有那边才这样做'的小事,用英语告诉我。

exercises.question: Your Japanese friend makes loud slurping noises while eating noodles. The best response is:
exercises.explanation: 对:在日本文化中,吃面出声是赞美厨师、表示好吃的礼貌行为。错:A/C/D 都是把本国餐桌礼仪强加于其他文化,缺乏对多元文化的理解。
options: A. Tell him it's rude to make noise at the table.
B. Understand that slurping shows he enjoys the food.
C. Assume he's doing it to annoy you.
D. Stop eating with him in the future.

exercises.question: In Brazil, people usually use ____ and ____ at meals, while people in Japan use chopsticks for noodles and make slurping sounds to show they like the food.
exercises.explanation: 巴西人西餐习惯用刀叉,而日本人吃面用筷子并发出吸溜声,这正体现同一动作(吃饭)各国做法完全不同的文化差异。

exercises.question: Why is the view that 'multiculturalism just means people eating together' too simplified? Give one example.
exercises.answer: Multiculturalism is more than sharing meals. It includes different values, greetings, table manners and history. For example, in Japan slurping noodles is polite, but in China or the West it is considered rude.
exercises.explanation: 1. 能指出多元文化≠一起吃饭(涉及价值观、礼仪、历史等多维度)。2. 给出具体国家对比例子。3. 用英语清晰表达文化差异背后的原因。

exercises.question: Your class is preparing a poster about multiculturalism for the school English Week. Choose THREE countries from the list (Japan, Brazil, Nigeria, France, India) and write ONE unique daily custom for each country in English. Then pick ONE of these customs and explain in 1-2 sentences why people in that country do it that way.
exercises.answer:
审题: 题目要求选 3 个国家, 各写 1 个日常独特习俗, 并解释其中一个习俗背后的原因。
分析: 考查多元文化中识别各国特有习俗 + 解释历史/地理/社会原因两个知识点。
解答: 1) Japan — People slurp noodles loudly when eating ramen, because the sound shows the chef the food is delicious and is a compliment. 2) Brazil — People often eat with fork and knife, even pizza, because of European (especially Portuguese) influence on table manners. 3) Nigeria — People greet with the left hand on the right shoulder and a bow, because respect for elders is very important in traditional Yoruba culture. I choose Japan: the slurping comes from the historical belief that hot noodle soup tastes better and feels more balanced when you breathe in steam while eating — so the sound is actually good manners.
exercises.explanation: 1. 至少正确写出 3 个国家各 1 个真实存在的日常习俗 (如 Japan slurping noodles, Brazil eating pizza with fork and knife, Nigeria greeting with a bow), 国家与习俗对应正确。2. 习俗描述用英语表达清晰, 句式通顺, 没有明显语法错误。3. 对所选习俗给出合理的历史 / 地理 / 社会原因解释, 体现对多元文化差异的理解, 而不是简单说 "because it's their culture"。

exercises.question: Some students say: "Multiculturalism just means different countries eat different food together. That's all." Write an English short passage (about 80-120 words) to evaluate this view. In your writing, you should: (1) give one example showing the same situation is done in opposite ways in two countries (e.g. greetings, dining, table manners); (2) explain why cultural differences go deeper than food; (3) end with your own opinion.
exercises.answer:
审题: 需要评价 "多元文化只是不同国家一起吃饭" 这种简化看法, 必须举反例 + 解释原因 + 给出观点。
分析: 综合考查对比文化差异 + 解释深层原因 + 反驳简化观点三大能力。
解答: I disagree with the view that multiculturalism is only about eating different food. Food is only a small part of culture. For example, when greeting others, Japanese people bow politely with quiet respect, while Brazilians often hug and kiss on the cheek warmly. The same situation — saying hello — is done in completely opposite ways. Behind these differences are deep reasons: Japan's bow comes from its history of samurai culture and group harmony, while Brazil's hug shows its open, mixed Latin and African society. Cultural differences also include family roles, time views, and how to show respect. So multiculturalism is about understanding different ways of thinking and living, not just sharing meals.
exercises.explanation: 1. 观点明确反对 "多元文化只是一起吃饭" 的简化说法, 并能用英语清楚表达 (I disagree / in my opinion 等)。2. 给出同一情境下两国相反做法的具体对比 (如 greetings: Japan bows vs. Brazil hugs), 体现对比维度。3. 解释文化差异背后的历史 / 地理 / 社会原因, 而不是停留在表面现象。4. 结尾给出自己的评价, 80-120 字, 语言通顺, 语法错误较少, 体现综合论述能力。
